provenance.prompt:
A UI frame of the panel of the midcore UI style for a competitive card battler of chunky heroes, stone forts and lane pushes on floating islands: a panel's border and ground, its centre plain so text reads on it.
Style: Inked comic 3D. Volumetric models keep bold outlines, drawn surface marks and exaggerated colour: a comic page given depth. Comic ink over 3D: heavy outlines, hatched shading painted in, punchy colour, exaggerated shapes.
Palette: free, saturated; bold local colours, black ink for all shadow edges.
Nine-slice: the corners (25% left, 25% top, 25% right, 25% bottom of each cell) keep their size, the edges between them stretch along one axis and the centre both ways: put every ornament in the corners, keep the edges even along their length and the centre plain.
Conform: the cook then the look's 3-pixel outline drawn round the shape (docs/art.md §2.3): draw for that.
Background: fully transparent, nothing outside the subject.
Line: a near-black #0a0810 line about 3 pixels wide at the size it is seen.
Reference: the image shows the style; match its palette, line and rendering, not its content.
Avoid: photoreal textures; thin outlines; muted colour; a background or ground shadow; text, letters or watermarks.
Shape: one single panel only, centred, filling the image across its width, 1.00 times as wide as it is tall (96 x 96 proportions); nothing else in the image.
Art direction: A chunky stone interface panel, completely opaque and solid everywhere including its centre (no hole, no transparency, no vignette): a flat dark slate-grey (#2e343b) slab with rounded corners (about 12 px at this size), a thick 3 px near-black (#14171b) outline, a lighter slate (#4a525b) bevelled rim along its top and left inner edges and a darker rim along its bottom, and one small grey steel rivet bolt in each of its four corners. As the panels of the concept's hero upgrade and settings screens. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): every ornament sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.
The reference images are the approved concept of this style's screens: paint this piece as it appears there, in their exact material, colour, ornament and finish; do not copy their layout or text.
